name: Menara Voidrender
summary: In Ratchet, Menara Voidrender teaches warlocks from both factions the dark arts. The human warlock shares her knowledge of demon-binding artifacts and arcane craft from a refuge in Kalimdor, far from orthodox authorities.

sections.title: A Refuge in Ratchet
sections.body: Menara Voidrender works from Ratchet, the neutral goblin port in the Barrens. Many warlocks in the Eastern Kingdoms study in cellars or hidden slaughterhouses beneath their cities, but Ratchet keeps Menara away from the Kirin Tor, Stormwind's guards, and Orgrimmar's overseers. There, she can pursue occult studies in plain sight. She teaches any capable apprentice, whatever their faction, making her a rare meeting point for practitioners of the dark arts.

sections.title: Mistress of Binding
sections.body: Veteran conjurers know Menara as an authority on orbs that imprison and harness demonic spirits. She works with intricate reagents and guides apprentices through demanding rituals to make enchanted attire and binding implements. Her skill is known as far as Ironforge and the Undercity, and senior warlocks across Azeroth send their most promising students across the sea to seek her counsel.

sections.title: Ties to the Marsh
sections.body: Menara Voidrender shares an old history with Tabetha, a hermit mage living in deep isolation in the swamps of Dustwallow Marsh. Tabetha pursues the arcane, while Menara studies fel bindings and demonology. When powerful relics such as the Orb of Orahil need restoration or special knowledge, their shared past bridges the wilderness of Kalimdor.

aliases: who is the warlock in ratchet
faq.answer: Menara Voidrender is a human warlock in Ratchet, the neutral port in the Barrens. She instructs developing warlocks in crafting rituals and demon-binding sorcery.

faq.q: Why is a human warlock living in the Barrens?
aliases: why is she in the barrens
faq.answer: Ratchet gives Menara neutrality and distance from the watchful eyes of major governments. From the goblin port, she practices forbidden arts and teaches students from both factions without interference from paladins, mages, or city guards.

faq.q: What kind of magic does Menara specialize in?
faq.answer: Menara specializes in demonology, enchanted dark fabrics, and vessels that trap demonic entities. She is especially known for creating and restoring binding orbs such as the Orb of Orahil.

faq.q: What is Menara's connection to Tabetha?
faq.answer: Menara and Tabetha share a past connection. Tabetha lives in seclusion in Dustwallow Marsh and practices traditional wizardry; warlocks seeking knowledge of the Orb of Orahil find that the two women know each other's talents.

faq.q: Does Menara favor the Alliance or the Horde?
faq.answer: Menara operates neutrally from Ratchet. She teaches and offers crafting work to capable, ambitious warlocks from both the Alliance and the Horde who can handle fel energies.

faq.q: What major artifacts does she help create?
faq.answer: Menara guides apprentices in weaving the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe, a garment imbued with demonic power. She also helps advanced practitioners recover and assemble components for the Orb of Orahil.

angles.text: As a warlock, you can learn from Menara, who teaches practitioners from both factions to forge enchanted robes and bind demons into focus orbs.
As a human, you see Menara pursuing the dark arts in neutral territory, away from Stormwind's catacombs and kingdom loyalties.
As a tailor, you can learn how Menara combines advanced tailoring materials with fel reagents to weave durable vestments that channel demonic power.
